title: Every countable group embeds in a group of type $\mathrm{FP}_n$
summary: For every integer $n\ge2$, we prove that every countable group embeds in a group of type $\mathrm{FP}_n$. We also construct a group of type $\mathrm{F}_n$ containing a copy of every recursively presented group. Consequently, a finitely generated group embeds in a group of type $\mathrm{F}_n$ if and only if it is recursively presented. This answers questions of Fournier-Facio and Zaremsky, and confirms a suggestion of Gromov.
